purpose: Observed and proposed name ownership across Josh's game projects. This is a working registry, not a claim that every name is unique or intentional.
rules: One core NPC name = one universe, unless the registry explicitly marks it as shared canon.
Reserve name+role pairs: a new mayor should not be another Rowan, a new innkeeper should not be another Tessa.
Run the name audit before adding a core NPC, place or faction.
Do not use a static banlist as the only control; track displaced names and cross-project reuse.
Prefer a culturally and phonologically grounded name over a familiar 'fantasy-safe' name.
Record provenance: human-authored, model-generated, or adapted, and who approved it.

names.name: Mira
names.decision: Reserve Mira for Lantern Road unless the games are explicitly linked. Rename WILDY's Keeper and Astra's opening NPC, or make the shared-universe connection canonical.

names.name: Kael
names.decision: Treat dndgame and SwordCoast as one code family; rename Kael if StarHaven is a separate universe.

names.name: Rowan
names.decision: Keep Rowan Pike as the Grey March mayor. Do not reuse the name+mayor pairing in a new universe; use a different name or explicitly link the setting.

names.name: Tessa
names.decision: Keep Tessa Reed as the Grey March innkeeper. Do not create another innkeeper named Tessa.

names.name: Elira
names.decision: Keep Sister Elira as the Grey March priest. Treat as a shared-setting character, not a generic name.

names.name: Lyra
names.decision: Avoid using Lyra for a new musician or bard; it is already a voiced character in Repository Town.

names.name: Thorne
names.decision: Avoid using Thorne as a shortcut villain surname; it is already part of Schism’s naming field.

names.name: Bran
